scene_briefs.micro_anchor: the central communication map separating contact, nearby chemical signaling, and distant chemical signaling
scene_briefs.orientation_sentence: Enter Communication Compass and stop at the central communication map separating contact, nearby chemical signaling, and distant chemical signaling. The direct-contact lane is fixed on the left, the communication-scale map is directly ahead at the working center, and the distance-signaling lane is fixed on the right. Those anchors stay in place while the scientific action unfolds.

unit_guide.name: Dr. Mira Chen
unit_guide.role: cellular-systems investigator who accompanies the learner through all seven Unit 4 journeys
unit_guide.visual_identity: charcoal field jacket, clear protective glasses, compact white tablet with an amber route cursor and a thin violet tracing light
unit_guide.behavior_rule: Mira first fixes the learner in a stable physical location, then identifies the biological parts, activates only one diagnostic interaction at a time, and names terminology after the defining structure or action is visible.

stable_cast.name: direct-contact lane
stable_cast.visual_identity: A conventional, clearly labeled scientific representation of direct-contact lane fixed on the learner’s left in the communication mode map display.
stable_cast.job_in_scene: Establish the starting condition, one comparison, or the input that must be interpreted before the central mechanism acts.

stable_cast.name: communication-scale map
stable_cast.visual_identity: The largest working scientific model in the room, centered on the central communication map separating contact, nearby chemical signaling, and distant chemical signaling; moving parts are confined to this central action zone.
stable_cast.job_in_scene: Perform the diagnostic mechanism that defines this locus: Place the same sender and target on the communication-scale map, first touching, then separated by a short local distance, then separated by a body-scale distance; change only the communication route so distance is the diagnostic feature.

stable_cast.name: distance-signaling lane
stable_cast.visual_identity: A conventional scientific representation of distance-signaling lane fixed on the learner’s right; its visible state changes only after the center mechanism produces an outcome.
stable_cast.job_in_scene: Display the consequence, destination, competing alternative, or resolved state that proves what the central mechanism did.

scene_briefs.continuity_object: Mira’s transparent route card, which always shows four fields—sender, messenger/contact, travel route or distance, and target—and is updated after every communication mode without pretending the card itself is a biological molecule.
scene_briefs.scene_problem: At this location the learner must resolve the relationship represented by the central communication map separating contact, nearby chemical signaling, and distant chemical signaling without changing the fixed left/center/right geometry.

science_bearing_action.before: All three zones are visible but unresolved. The left state (direct-contact lane) supplies the input or comparison, the center (communication-scale map) is inactive, and the right (distance-signaling lane) has not yet updated, so the learner cannot yet infer the mechanism.
science_bearing_action.trigger: Mira identifies the unresolved biological relationship and activates only the minimum structures needed to make that mechanism observable.
during: Place the same sender and target on the communication-scale map, first touching, then separated by a short local distance, then separated by a body-scale distance; change only the communication route so distance is the diagnostic feature.

Make the contact lane work without a secreted long-range messenger, make the local lane deliver only within a nearby radius, and make the distance lane require transport or another long-range route before the target can receive the signal.
Update Mira’s route card after each case so the learner leaves with sender, route, distance, and target as the four comparison dimensions rather than one vague category called signaling.
science_bearing_action.after: Freeze the resolved state with direct-contact lane still on the left, communication-scale map in the center, and distance-signaling lane on the right. The learner should be able to reconstruct what changed, what caused the change, and which structure or signal carried the consequence.

science_bearing_action.before: All three zones are visible but unresolved. during: Activate an upstream enzyme such as adenylyl cyclase and convert a relatively small input into many molecules of a small intracellular messenger, using cAMP as the named example.
Distribute the cAMP molecules to multiple downstream targets so one receptor-level event can influence many intracellular components and visibly amplify the signal.

causal_transition.transition_logic: The security journey closes only after the learner can reconstruct normal checkpoint permission, cyclin–CDK control, apoptosis, external proliferation constraints, cancer-control failure, tumor progression, metastasis, and evidence-based carcinogen risk without turning any single feature into the definition of cancer.
